description: This file defines a PHP class 'Cosecant' that provides static methods for calculating the cosecant and hyperbolic cosecant of an angle, including support for array inputs. It is part of the PhpSpreadsheet library's calculation module, specifically for mathematical trigonometric functions.

classes.name: Cosecant
classes.description: A class providing static methods to compute cosecant and hyperbolic cosecant functions for angles, with support for arrays.

methods.name: csc
methods.description: Calculates the cosecant (reciprocal of sine) of an angle, supporting scalar or array inputs.

methods.name: csch
methods.description: Calculates the hyperbolic cosecant of an angle, supporting scalar or array inputs.
